title: Login to UA HPC
author: Ken Youens-Clark
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wvwfe7e

steps.title: Initial HPC Login
steps.instruction: Establish an initial connection to the UA HPC system using a terminal.

substeps.instruction: Enter NetID password and complete 2-factor authentication.
Select 'D' from the target system menu to disable the menu.

steps.title: Configure Public Key for Passwordless Login
steps.instruction: Set up SSH keys on the local machine and the HPC to enable faster login.

substeps.instruction: Open a second terminal on the local machine and navigate to '~/.ssh'.
If the directory does not exist, execute 'ssh-keygen' and accept all defaults.
Copy the public key text using 'cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub' (or 'pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub' on MacOS).
In the HPC terminal (@gatekeeper), open '~/.ssh/authorized_keys' (create it if it does not exist) and add the copied public key text.
Set the file permissions to 600 using 'chmod 600'.

steps.title: Verify Passwordless Login
steps.instruction: Test the SSH key configuration from the local terminal.

substeps.instruction: Execute 'ssh @hpc.arizona.edu' to verify automatic login without 2-factor authentication.

steps.title: Create Login Alias
steps.instruction: Configure a local SSH config file to simplify the login command.

substeps.instruction: Add the following lines: 'Host hpc', 'Hostname hpc.arizona.edu', and 'User [User]'.
Verify the alias by executing 'ssh hpc' on the local machine.
